title: 第二十六章 咱有钱第二十七章 缠上
content_zh:
林昆费了好一顿的口沫，小家伙才答应不把他说看过楚静瑶小蝴蝶的话告诉楚静瑶，当然他为此也付出了代价，今天晚上睡觉前给小家伙讲十个有关超人的故事。
晚上睡觉，小楚澄还是睡中间，林昆和楚静瑶睡两侧，三口家合盖一个大夏凉被。
小孩子睡觉快，没一会儿就呼呼上了，林昆躺在床上却没什么睡意，半夜的时候他还没睡着，却听到楚静瑶在旁边小声的痛吟，然后下床一瘸一拐的去了客厅，一阵轻微的哗啦啦声传来，她好像在找什么东西。
林昆这时才想起来，他本来打算给楚静瑶按摩按摩脚的，却不小心给忘了。
林昆也悄悄的下床，来到了客厅，楚静瑶正坐在沙发上往脚踝上涂药，边涂边痛的皱起眉头，也难怪，脚踝肿的跟鸡蛋似的，不痛才怪呢。
林昆朝楚静瑶走了过去，楚静瑶抬起头看了他一眼，没说话。林昆蹲在了楚静瑶的跟前，伸手拿过楚静瑶正在涂的药，看了看说：“这药只有缓解的作用，治标不治本。”
楚静瑶揉着脚踝没说话，额头上因为疼痛渗出一层细汗，眉头也深皱着。
“你等我。”
林昆起身向卫生间走去，从里面端出一盆热水和一条毛巾，把水盆放在楚静瑶的跟前，毛巾搭在自己肩上，对楚静瑶说：“把脚放到水里。”
楚静瑶不为所动，林昆主动抓起她的脚放在脸盆里，楚静瑶被热水烫的‘嘶’了一声，林昆低着头一边用热水往她的脚踝上敷，一边说：“忍着点，待会儿就不疼了。”
楚静瑶咬牙忍住，看着低着头一脸认真的林昆，心里的感觉说不清。
用热水敷了一会儿之后，林昆开始用手轻轻的按摩楚静瑶的脚踝，疼痛的感觉马上又来了，但同时也伴随着一阵说不出来的舒服，楚静瑶不由的轻轻的哼了一声，这一声哼的很暧昧，又好像是在呻吟一样。
林昆抬起头冲她笑了一下，楚静瑶顿时脸颊滚烫，抿着嘴唇咬紧嘴巴。
随着按摩的力道越来越大，动作的幅度越来越深，脚踝处的疼痛感越来越轻了，相反那舒服的感觉越来越浓烈了，就好像一阵阵电流顺着脚踝传向全身，在身体里跌宕起阵阵酥麻的感觉，楚静瑶情不禁的又哼了一声，这一声比之前的那声更加的暧昧，就好像是在床上发出的那声音。
楚静瑶赶紧捂住自己的嘴巴，脸颊滚烫滚烫的，林昆低头笑着说：“有什么好害羞的，舒服就叫出来呗，咱俩又不是小孩子了，澄澄都那么大了。”
楚静瑶捂着嘴巴没吭声，目光倒是冷冽的白了林昆一眼，意思是别瞎说话。
“好了！”
林昆把楚静瑶的脚从脸盆里拿出来，用毛巾替她擦干，抬起头说：“你先稍微的活动一下看看，看看还疼不疼了。”
楚静瑶轻轻的晃动了一下脚踝，竟然真的感觉不到疼痛了。
“怎么样？”林昆问。

“不疼了。”楚静瑶道。
“那站起来慢慢的走两步。”
楚静瑶站了起来，光着脚丫在地摊上试探性的走了两步，然后便开始正常的走了起来，脚踝处的疼痛还在，但已经轻的可以忽略不计了。
“怎么样？”林昆问。
“几乎感觉不到疼了。”楚静瑶开心的道。
“那行了，收拾收拾赶紧睡觉吧，明天早上醒过来估计就好的差不多了，但这两天记住别穿高跟鞋了，要是不小心再扭一下，就难办了。”林昆叮嘱道。
“哦。”楚静瑶答应道。
林昆端起脸盆和毛巾，朝卫生间走去，这时身后传来了楚静瑶的声音：“谢谢你啊……”声音不大，但能听的出是发自肺腑真心实意的。
林昆脚下迟缓了一下，笑了笑但没回头，继续端着脸盆向卫生间走去。
换了新地方，章小雅晚上失眠了，她失眠其实也不完全因为换新地方，而是住在她隔壁的那个男人，白天短短的相聚，让她对林昆有了更深一点的了解，知道了他的童年出身，也看出了他对朋友的那一份热忱。
现在这个社会，很多女生都瞧不起农村出身的男生，因为乡下多贫穷，社会又是那么的现实拜金，就拿她之前的三个室友来说吧，每当说到农村出身的男同学时，话语腔调里总带有这样那样不屑轻蔑的味道。
今天一天她都请假没去上课，三个室友是知道她今天要搬家的，却没一个人说要帮她的忙，只有蒋晓珊还算关心的问起过她要搬去哪里，她说了一句是一个挺偏的地方，蒋晓珊便马上没了下文，抱着杂志去上课去了。
content_en:
Lin Kun spent a lot of time foaming at the mouth before the little guy agreed not to tell Chu Jingyao what he said he had seen Chu Jingyao's little butterfly. Of course, he paid the price for this. He told the little guy ten stories about Superman before going to bed tonight.
When sleeping at night, little Chu Cheng slept in the middle, Lin Kun and Chu Jingyao slept on both sides, and the three of them shared a large summer quilt.
The child fell asleep quickly and soon fell asleep. Lin Kun was lying on the bed but he didn't feel sleepy. In the middle of the night, he was still awake, but he heard Chu Jingyao moaning in pain next to him. Then he got out of bed and limped to the living room. There was a slight clattering sound, as if she was looking for something.
Only then did Lin Kun remember that he had originally planned to massage Chu Jingyao's feet, but accidentally forgot about it.
Lin Kun also quietly got out of bed and came to the living room. Chu Jingyao was sitting on the sofa applying medicine to her ankle. She frowned in pain while applying it. It was no wonder that her ankle was swollen like an egg. It was strange that it didn't hurt.
Lin Kun walked towards Chu Jingyao. Chu Jingyao raised her head and glanced at him without saying anything. Lin Kun squatted in front of Chu Jingyao, reached out and took the medicine Chu Jingyao was applying, looked at it and said, "This medicine only has a relieving effect, it treats the symptoms but not the root cause."
Chu Jingyao rubbed her ankle and said nothing. A thin layer of sweat broke out on her forehead because of the pain, and her brows were deeply furrowed.
"Wait for me."
Lin Kun got up and walked to the bathroom, took out a basin of hot water and a towel, placed the basin in front of Chu Jingyao, put the towel on his shoulders, and said to Chu Jingyao: "Put your feet in the water."
Chu Jingyao was unmoved. Lin Kun took the initiative to grab her feet and put them in the basin. Chu Jingyao hissed from the hot water. Lin Kun lowered his head and applied hot water to her ankles while saying, "Be patient, it won't hurt after a while."
Chu Jingyao gritted her teeth and held back, looking at Lin Kun with his head lowered and a serious expression on his face, she couldn't explain her feelings in her heart.
After applying hot water for a while, Lin Kun began to gently massage Chu Jingyao's ankle with his hands. The pain came back immediately, but it was also accompanied by an indescribable feeling of comfort. Chu Jingyao couldn't help but hum softly. The hum was very ambiguous and seemed to be moaning.
Lin Kun raised his head and smiled at her. Chu Jingyao's cheeks suddenly became hot, she pursed her lips and bit her mouth.
As the massage force became stronger and the movements became deeper and deeper, the pain in the ankle became lighter and lighter. On the contrary, the comfortable feeling became stronger and stronger, as if waves of electric current were transmitted along the ankle to the whole body, causing waves of numbness in the body. Chu Jingyao couldn't help but hummed again. This one was more ambiguous than the previous one, just like the sound made on the bed.
Chu Jingyao quickly covered her mouth, her cheeks were burning hot. Lin Kun lowered his head and said with a smile: "What's there to be ashamed of? Just scream if you feel comfortable. We are not children anymore, Chengcheng is already that old."
Chu Jingyao covered her mouth and said nothing, but gave Lin Kun a cold look, meaning to stop talking nonsense.
"Okay!"
Lin Kun took Chu Jingyao's feet out of the basin, wiped them dry with a towel, raised his head and said, "First move around a little to see if it still hurts."
Chu Jingyao shook her ankle slightly, and she really couldn't feel the pain anymore.
"How is it?" Lin Kun asked.
"It doesn't hurt anymore." Chu Jingyao said.
"Then stand up and take two steps slowly."
Chu Jingyao stood up, took two tentative steps on the stall with bare feet, and then began to walk normally. The pain in her ankle was still there, but it was so light that it could be ignored.
"How is it?" Lin Kun asked.
"I can hardly feel the pain anymore." Chu Jingyao said happily.
"Okay, pack up and go to bed. I'll probably be fine when you wake up tomorrow morning. But remember not to wear high heels these two days. If you accidentally twist them,It will be difficult to handle. " Lin Kun warned.
"Oh. "Chu Jingyao agreed.
Lin Kun picked up the washbasin and towel and walked towards the bathroom. At this time, Chu Jingyao's voice came from behind: "Thank you..." The voice was not loud, but it could be heard that it was from the bottom of his heart.
Lin Kun hesitated for a moment, smiled but did not look back, and continued to walk towards the bathroom with the basin in his hand.
After moving to a new place, Zhang Xiaoya had insomnia at night. In fact, her insomnia was not entirely due to the new place, but to the man who lived next door to her. Their brief get-together during the day gave her a deeper understanding of Lin Kun. She learned about his childhood background and saw his enthusiasm for his friends.
In today's society, many girls look down on boys from rural areas, because the countryside is so poor and the society is so money-worshipping. Take her three previous roommates as an example. Whenever they talk about male classmates from rural areas, their tone of voice always contains some kind of disdain and contempt.
She took a day off today and did not go to class. The three roommates knew that she was moving today, but no one said they wanted to help her. Only Jiang Xiaoshan was concerned and asked where she was moving to. She said it was a quite remote place, and Jiang Xiaoshan immediately stopped talking and went to class with the magazine in her arms.
